paced.scope: 1x software replay; no camera, recording load, Windows bridge or AFG commands
paced.timing_limit: Latency is local replay timing, not exposure-to-result latency

host.limitations: Windows PagesInput includes file-backed reads across all processes. It is NOT WSL pagefile traffic. No direct cross-OS clock subtraction. CPU/host monitoring can perturb the run; compare like-for-like recordings.
